bear_assumptions: USD 7.50 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 24x; AI-infrastructure growth decelerates, China remains unavailable, Rubin or supply execution raises costs, and the valuation multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: USD 9.00 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 28x; Q2 guidance converts, Blackwell remains strong, Rubin ships broadly on schedule, and roughly mid-70% gross margin supports continued cash generation.
bull_assumptions: USD 11.00 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 34x; sovereign, enterprise, networking, and hyperscale demand compound, Rubin expands platform breadth, and margins remain exceptional.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears every expected-return, base-upside, bear/base-payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, and relationship gate after current results; downgrade if Data Center growth or margins weaken materially, Rubin is delayed, export controls intensify, supply commitments require material provisions, customer AI capital spending slows, or normalized per-share earnings and cash flow stop compounding.
